With the information now, I can't figure out the problem.
Is this really reproducible periodically? Then How about try gdb as below?

```
$ gdb /usr/bin/open5gs-mmed
...
(if crashed)
> bt
```

Thanks a lot!
Sukchan

Hi @acetcom 

Yes. this is very repeatable. Studying the logs more, I have found something interesting - most crashes seem to be caused by a particular IMSI `999017364100351` doing a service request; but not all. Will try and find out what particular CPE that is - we are evaluating a number of different indoor and outdoor units. 

I will compile and run with your additional logging commit above to see what additional information that shows.
